scraping.clean module

clean.py Cleans and parses admissions results scraped from GradCafe. clean_data is called from scrape.py.

scraping.clean.clean_data(results: list, url)[source]

Clean the raw html list of admissions results into readable dictionaries.

Parameters:

  • results (list[bs4.Tag]) – The raw <tr> rows scraped from a results page.

  • url (str) – The results page URL, used to resolve each result’s relative link into an absolute one.

Returns:

A list of dictionaries, each containing relevant information about a single result.

Return type:

list[dict]
